finding.title: Stablecoin supply context equal-clock source tie ignores data_quality and changes under source-label renaming
finding.mechanism: For two visible stablecoin component_supply_usd rows for USDT with equal effective_at_ms, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms but distinct source/source_record_id and no economic_event_id, normalize_and_dedup keeps both and sorts by source. build_stablecoin_context latest_supply chooses only strict rank >, so first lexical source wins without inspecting data_quality. Merely swapping source labels can change selected tracked_supply_usd with economic values, timestamps and qualities held fixed.

minimal_exact_repo_pytest_oracle.setup: Construct FlowObservation A: family=stablecoin, metric=component_supply_usd, asset=USDT, value=1000, unit=USD, source=a_low, source_record_id=rec-a, data_quality=0.10, effective_at_ms=T, available_at_ms=T, observed_at_ms=T, economic_event_id=None. Construct B with same family/metric/asset/unit/clocks, value=1200, source=z_high, source_record_id=rec-b, data_quality=1.00, economic_event_id=None. Choose T<=as_of_ms and both PIT-visible. All other fields default.
minimal_exact_repo_pytest_oracle.calls: Build contexts for [A,B], [B,A], and [A',B'] with only the two source strings swapped between A and B.
expected_assertions: PIT-visible contexts must be input-order independent

Economic supply result must not change merely because source labels are renamed while economic evidence/quality/clocks are unchanged; assert original.tracked_supply_usd == renamed.tracked_supply_usd (source predicts FAIL)
If equal-clock cross-source disagreement is unresolved, expose an explicit conflict/ambiguity quality flag instead of silently treating lexical source name as quality ranking
Do not modify frozen scoring or conflate stablecoin context with independent directional flow

finding.lane_separation: C downstream selection/quality only; separate from A archive/integration and B source breadth.
